Subagent threads wait for their parent to settle, archive or be deleted, then settle once idle, and a child sharing its parent's worktree skips the settle action. Expect a conflict in apps/server/src/orchestration-v2/ThreadSettlementService.ts with fork #1281 (ledger settle-action-last-open-thread). At intake, take upstream's subagent handling and keep #1281's guard, which holds the action while a sibling thread is open or any thread in the worktree is working. Upstream runs the action under a working child, so the working check has to stay too. Upstream's child skip removes the re-run where an idle subagent settling after its parent ran the action again; children in their own worktree keep their own run. Check one gap when combining them: if a parent settles while a child in its worktree is working, the guard holds the parent's action and the child skip then drops it, so the action never runs for that worktree. Either let the child run it when the parent's was held, or accept it, since the only effect is servers and state left in place. Update the ledger invariants and the styal-differences entry to match.
